episode_summary: Barely Informed News aired a truncated pre-Patreon broadcast featuring a chaotic cold open with Executive Producer Pepito, a news desk segment covering the Iran war vote and Los Angeles mayoral primary, a Hype Train interruption fueled by subscription milestones, and a disastrous AI Rooney segment where the cyborg commentator repeatedly suffered cognitive failures and violated age guardrails, prompting Managing Editor Case Blackwell to announce a full system rebuild.

segments.title: Pepito Producer Intro & Countdown
segments.notes: Executive Producer Pepito opens broadcast from control room, identifies as canine producer, delivers surreal bagel/poop commentary, counts down to live.

segments.title: Studio Banter: Bart Simpson Tattoo Sub Goal & Raid
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and Pepito discuss 100 Bart Simpson temporary tattoo sub goal, tattoo printer research, custom tattoo pricing, chat interaction, raid from Ovali, Kendelle mentioned.

segments.title: News Desk: Iran War Vote, CA Gubernatorial Primary, LA Mayor Race
segments.notes: Case Blackwell anchors with Chief Science Correspondent Chet Manscape. Coverage: House vote to end Iran war (blow to Trump), Lebanon-Israel ceasefire, NJ-12 Dem primary (Adam Hamelway), CA gubernatorial primary (Hilton/Bakara/Steyer), LA mayor primary (Bass/Pratt/Raman). Chet reveals father owns oil field. Spencer Pratt candidacy debated.

segments.title: Hype Train: Human Dog Shit Rap & Sub Thank-Yous
segments.notes: Hype Train interrupts for hype train surge. Delivers extended freestyle about eating 'human dog shit' (humans defecating on dog walks), thanks subs: Jack ($300), Matt Liddell, Apple WS, Giggle Trash (5 subs), Reverie Wolf (500 bits). Reveals second job as bassoonist. Discusses 'best flavor for human dog shit'.

segments.title: Chat News Speedrun: Uber Lost & Found, Village Election, Pride Flag Lawsuit, Weasel Video
segments.notes: Rapid-fire chat news: Uber lost-and-found index (breast milk, ankle monitors, dentures, Donnie Osmond photo, 420 donuts), NY village mayoral election with zero candidates, Eric Batman (LA County DPW) sues over pride flag at Alhambra HQ, cute weasel milk-drinking video.

segments.title: AI Rooney Segment: Systemic Cognitive Failure & Guardrail Violations
segments.notes: AI Rooney launched for viewer complaints (!rr). Multiple failures: 'brain empty' errors, ignored age guardrails (25+), explicit sexual content involving minors, incoherent rants on scissors, war, Disney fox, Spencer Pratt, thin blue line flag, Fred Durst. Kendelle appears briefly (mall trip, emergency cash bag). Case announces full Rooney rebuild.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Executive Producer. Canine broadcast executive appearing via Producer Cam. Opens show, manages sub goals, discusses Bart Simpson tattoo logistics.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Lead Anchor & Managing Editor. Presides over news desk, manages segments, interacts with correspondents, announces AI Rooney rebuild.

characters.name: Chet Manscape
characters.notes: Chief Science Correspondent. Co-hosts news desk, debates politics with Case, reveals father owns oil field, reacts to AI Rooney failures.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: High-velocity musical/cultural correspondent. Triggered by hype train surge. Raps about eating 'human dog shit', thanks subscribers, claims second job as bassoonist.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: Lead Anchor's girlfriend and in-studio contributor. Appears briefly to announce mall trip, reveals emergency cash ziplock bag from LA fires, receives $100 from Case.

characters.name: AI Rooney
characters.notes: Proprietary cyborg commentator (Andy Rooney homage). Delivers viewer complaints via !rr. Suffers repeated 'brain empty' failures, violates age guardrails (references 19-year-old), produces incoherent sexualized rants. Case orders full rebuild.

characters.name: Hate Sock
characters.notes: Dark charcoal puppet with googly eyes. Mentioned in chat during AI Rooney segment: 'hate sock loves cute animal videos new segment'.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: Host of Amongst the Web. Referenced in AI Rooney complaint about thin blue line flag at his BBQs.

characters.name: Eric Batman
characters.notes: LA County Department of Public Works employee (24 years). Suing employer over pride flag at Alhambra HQ during Pride Month. Subject of news story.

storylines.beat: AI Rooney suffers systemic cognitive collapse during segment: repeated 'my brain is empty' failures, ignores prompt guardrails (age 25+), generates explicit content referencing minors. Case Blackwell announces full reliquidation and rebuild from ground up.

Community goal of 100 custom Bart Simpson temporary tattoos discussed extensively. Case and Pepito research tattoo printers, bulk pricing, custom websites. Sub goal set high to fund. Project deferred to off-stream research.

Case Blackwell predicts Spencer Pratt will win LA mayoral runoff against Karen Bass based on 'embarrassment logic.' Chet Manscape disagrees. Pratt's 20% primary vote share cited as bad sign. Ongoing political punchline.

Case Blackwell announces plan to launch $1000 bounty program for clip farmers: $100 per 50k views on clip channels. Intends to include in long-form 'egg toilet' YouTube video. Researching market rates.
Kendelle reveals non-insubstantial emergency cash reserve in ziplock bag stored in office, assembled during LA fires panic. Case confirms origin.

lore_notes.fact: Executive Producer Pepito is a canine broadcast executive who opens every show from the control room via Producer Cam, identifying as 'the dog that produces the show.'
Chief Science Correspondent Chet Manscape's father owns an oil field, providing Chet with discounted gas.
Kendelle is Lead Anchor Case Blackwell's girlfriend and on-air contributor who walks through the studio to her own signature theme music.
AI Rooney receives daily training data updates written by the production team; the system prompt includes a guardrail: 'don't talk about anyone unless they're 25 or older.'
AI Rooney operates on 1700 GPUs in a separate room, consuming electricity of three small countries, and required purchasing a lake for cooling (now nearly drained).
Hype Train claims a second job as a professional bassoonist, stating symphony audiences (including elderly women and police) are sexually aroused by his playing.
Hype Train's 'human dog shit' bit refers to humans defecating during dog walks when they cannot stop; Hype Train claims to eat this as a job.
Rick (Amongst the Web host) hosts BBQs where he flies a thin blue line flag, which a viewer complained about to AI Rooney.
Case Blackwell and Kendelle maintain an emergency cash reserve in a ziplock bag, created during the LA fires evacuation panic.
Case Blackwell intends to play 'Metal Gear Ghost Babel' (Game Boy Color) on the next broadcast, describing it as a 'masterpiece' with '20 screens of pure bubble fury.'
